milestones.title: Live TARGET IP column on the Game Boost rows
milestones.desc: Every Game Boost row now shows the live destination IPs of the app's connections (UDP first, duplicates collapsed, +N summary for the rest), so you can see which game servers an app is talking to right now.

milestones.title: Game Boost dashboard buttons wired end-to-end
milestones.desc: The ⚡ BSG API → WARP chip, the + Add domain form and the row reorder arrows actually work — the missing dashboard actions are now allow-listed and their wire payloads are locked by contract tests.

milestones.title: BSG launcher/API domains pinned to the launcher egress
milestones.desc: The full known BSG launcher/auth/API host set (escapefromtarkov.com, battlestategames.com, tarkov.com, escapefromtarkov.ru + explicit rows) is pinned to the launcher egress at the very top of the routing rules, closing the Cloudflare 'Fatal Error' from launcher traffic leaking into the tunnel.

milestones.title: One-click domain rules in Game Boost: ⚡ BSG API → WARP chip + manual domain form
milestones.desc: A destination rule can now be added from Game Boost in one click: the ⚡ BSG API → WARP chip inserts escapefromtarkov.com → WARP at the top of the routing list, and a general + Add domain form accepts any host[:port] with a route picker — both validate through the same parser as the native add flows.

milestones.title: Game Boost rows are reorderable: domain rules can take precedence
milestones.desc: Every Game Boost row has ↑/↓ move buttons, so a domain rule can sit above the process rule it must win over; the new order persists and auto-applies.

milestones.title: ⚡ Tarkov preset removed — Game Boost is fully manual
milestones.desc: The one-click Tarkov preset is gone per user request — Game Boost routing is configured by hand from now on; the hand-add suggestions and the native EFT tile stay.

milestones.title: GPN route mode & per-app route changes switch without a core restart
milestones.desc: Off / Global VPN / Game Tunnel and per-app route changes now switch the live tunnel by group selection instead of restarting the core — no re-handshake, no connection drop; only rule-set-changing edits still reload.

milestones.title: "Old node draining" status shown while a soft switch winds down
milestones.desc: After a restart-free node switch the dashboard shows the old node draining: it counts the connections still finishing on the previous node (amber), reports the drain as finished when they end, and leaves stragglers to end naturally.

milestones.title: GPN node switching without disconnecting (make-before-break)
milestones.desc: Changing node while connected (or a failover switch) is now a single make-before-break step: every candidate is listed under a GPN-Nodes select group and the switch is one API call — the process, TUN adapter and listeners stay up.

milestones.title: Exit deadlock fixed: a config flush could strand the UI thread and leave AoGPN running headless
milestones.desc: A sync-over-async deadlock inside the exit path (a config flush awaited on the blocked UI thread) could leave AoGPN running headless; the save queue and the graceful-exit flush now never depend on the caller's UI context.

milestones.title: Dashboard window-behaviour toggles apply instantly + Minimize-to-tray control
milestones.desc: Hide-to-tray and minimize-to-tray now apply instantly on change, the HTML close button mirrors the native caption X, and the settings form is re-pushed after every save so it can never drift from the real behaviour.

milestones.title: Exit: X can no longer leave an invisible process behind
milestones.desc: Closing with X can no longer leave AoGPN running invisibly: the whole exit is guarded by a watchdog with a hard deadline, a throwing Application.Exit subscriber can no longer skip the guaranteed exit, and orphan cores from force-killed runs are swept at startup.

milestones.title: Theme library expanded to 25
milestones.desc: The dashboard now ships 25 themes (up from the original 11) — Nebula, Inferno, Synthwave, Cyberpunk, Matrix, Crimson, Velocity, Aurora, Neon Cyber, Crimson Core and more — each with its own palette, signature effects and cursor/sound/confetti engines.

milestones.title: Standalone skins: NEXUS GPN, CYBER, INFRA
milestones.desc: The dashboard can be swapped for fully independent designs — self-contained HTML skins running in an isolated iframe, fed by a safe live bridge to the app state.

milestones.title: Real game-server ping: before/after on the boost cards
milestones.desc: Game Boost cards now show the REAL game-server latency, measured both before and after the GPN tunnel (ICMP with TCP fallback), with a color-coded before → after delta.

milestones.title: Game Boost spells out the blacklist inversion inline
milestones.desc: In blacklist mode the route column now names the effective action per row (outside-tunnel / tunneled chips) and the banner explains the inversion explicitly.

milestones.title: GPN blacklist: excluded apps no longer tunneled by the capture bridge
milestones.desc: The capture bridge now follows the same effective-route logic as manual routing, so excluded apps never get tunneled; the TUN-missing fallback strips managed rules and reports honestly.

milestones.title: Splash screen: fade-out, version and loading bar
milestones.desc: The splash now shows the app version and a live boot progress bar, and fades out smoothly instead of closing instantly.

milestones.title: Splash screen with the high-resolution AO GPN logo
milestones.desc: A new startup splash displays the high-resolution AO GPN logo.

milestones.title: Real AoGPN logo inside the dashboard branding
milestones.desc: The dashboard title bar and sidebar render the actual AO GPN logo image.

milestones.title: New app logo across the icon set
milestones.desc: App, window, status-bar and tray icons updated to the new AO GPN logo.

milestones.title: Stable node ping tests + sort by ping
milestones.desc: Re-running 'Test all' no longer self-cancels; nodes can be sorted by measured ping.

milestones.title: Tray: left click always brings the window back
milestones.desc: Tray left click shows the window even when it is merely minimized.

milestones.title: Foreign VPN clients are no longer auto-killed
milestones.desc: AoGPN no longer terminates third-party VPN clients: foreign-tunnel detection is report-only — it warns and logs, but closing another VPN is always the user's decision.

milestones.title: Tray: app can no longer vanish into a hidden, icon-less state
milestones.desc: Auto-hide-on-startup combined with minimize-to-tray can no longer leave the app unreachable from the tray.

milestones.title: Core orphan guard, resilient exit chain, verified downloads
milestones.desc: Orphan-core cleanup no longer kills other VPN clients; the exit chain is resilient and downloads are verified.

milestones.title: Node list batch actions & toolbar de-duplication
milestones.desc: Batch delete/disable work from the multi-select bar; toolbar controls de-duplicated.

milestones.title: User-approved Xray core fallback for REALITY nodes
milestones.desc: Falling back a failed REALITY node to the Xray core now requires explicit user approval.

milestones.title: Foreign VPN conflict warning before connecting
milestones.desc: Warns when another VPN/tunnel is detected before AoGPN starts its own tunnel.

milestones.title: Automatic core fallback for REALITY nodes
milestones.desc: Automatically falls back to the Xray core when the main core fails on a REALITY node.

milestones.title: Bundled Xray upgraded to 26.7.28 + REALITY regression test
milestones.desc: Bundled Xray core upgraded and covered by a new REALITY regression test.

milestones.title: Proxy-only egress verification script
milestones.desc: Adds an end-to-end script that verifies proxy-only egress.

milestones.title: Tray-hide invariant guarded by tests
milestones.desc: Minimize/close-to-tray routing is centralized and covered by tests.

milestones.title: Live tray status line
milestones.desc: The tray menu top now shows the real connection status live.

milestones.title: Tray exit vs close distinction
milestones.desc: 'Exit' no longer leaves a hidden zombie process; exit and close behave differently.

milestones.title: Proxy-only service testability
milestones.desc: The proxy-only engine moved into ServiceLib and is now unit-testable.

milestones.title: Minimize-to-tray and network-aware auto-start
milestones.desc: Adds a 'Minimize to tray' option and makes auto-start wait for the network to be ready.

milestones.title: One edit control: remove the duplicate "Edit mode" label
milestones.desc: The Nodes view has a single edit affordance; the duplicate label is gone.

milestones.title: System proxy works without a tunnel (v2rayN-style proxy-only mode)
milestones.desc: The OS system proxy now applies even when no GPN/Global tunnel is active (proxy-only mode).

milestones.title: Node pool: edit links behind the view's edit mode
milestones.desc: Pooled links can now be edited in place.

milestones.title: Nodes view: clipboard shortcuts stop fighting text inputs, selection fixes
milestones.desc: Ctrl+C / V / A / Delete / Backspace no longer hijack text inputs; node selection behaves sanely.

milestones.title: Nodes view: real checkbox toggle, batched real-ping, sane selection
milestones.desc: The card checkmark is a real toggle; real-ping is batched; selection no longer flakes.

milestones.title: GPN per-app capture: VPN routes now force TUN, honest running status
milestones.desc: VPN-routed apps (and Global VPN) now force TUN regardless of the transport choice so per-process routing actually applies.

milestones.title: Node dropdown no longer closes when scrolling the list
milestones.desc: Scrolling the open node list no longer closes the dropdown.

milestones.title: Translatable TUN Stack & Auto reconnect labels
milestones.desc: 'TUN Stack' and 'Auto reconnect' labels now translate with the rest of the UI.

milestones.title: Connection mode selector under the CONNECT button + ring effects
milestones.desc: A compact mode selector (GPN | Global) sits under the CONNECT ring and stays synced with every other selector.

milestones.title: Fix broken sidebar Connection panel layout
milestones.desc: The sidebar Connection panel no longer overflows or clips in any language.

milestones.title: Keyboard accessibility for the themed dropdowns
milestones.desc: The language dropdown is fully keyboard-operable (arrows, Home/End, Enter/Escape).

milestones.title: Compact sidebar Connection panel in Status layout
milestones.desc: The sidebar Connection panel is noticeably shorter with a compact two-column layout.

milestones.title: Theme-consistent language dropdown
milestones.desc: The native white select is replaced by a dark themed popover for the language list.

milestones.title: Layout as a theme axis: Status ↔ Compact
milestones.desc: The dashboard layout is now selectable like a theme: Status or Compact.

milestones.title: Status-first dashboard: connection controls move to the sidebar
milestones.desc: The hero is status-first; connection controls moved into a compact sidebar panel.

milestones.title: Quick connect/disconnect in the mobile icon nav
milestones.desc: The mobile icon nav gained a power button that mirrors the CONNECT ring.

milestones.title: Mobile nav: Performance & Settings reachable + active state
milestones.desc: All five views are reachable from the mobile bottom nav with active states.

milestones.title: UX polish from a real-user walkthrough
milestones.desc: Page titles localize instantly; several walkthrough-found issues fixed.

milestones.title: Adaptive gauge calibration for real bandwidth
milestones.desc: Download/upload gauges auto-calibrate to your actual link instead of a fixed 25/12 Mbps scale.

milestones.title: Re-assert TUN fail-safe routes on every settings save
milestones.desc: TUN fail-safe routes are re-applied whenever settings change (MTU, auto-route, strict-route, legacy-protect).

milestones.title: Remove fake UI: honest status dot, live session node, dead subscription bridges
milestones.desc: The status dot is honest, the active session node is live, and dead subscription bridges are removed.

milestones.title: Remove unused WFP probe machinery
milestones.desc: Removed the unused WFP probe and its dashboard badge.

milestones.title: Surface WFP status + quick TUN stack selector
milestones.desc: The dashboard now surfaces a WFP status badge and a quick TUN stack selector.

milestones.title: Show effective routes in the boost table for GPN blacklist
milestones.desc: The boost table shows the effective route with a ⇄ Blacklist marker in blacklist mode.

milestones.title: Explain the Global VPN capture lock
milestones.desc: A 🔒 badge explains why capture is locked when Global VPN forces TUN.

milestones.title: Merge per-app connection options to 3 real choices
milestones.desc: Per-app connection options are now three honest choices: VPN, Direct, Block.

milestones.title: Connection-logic overhaul: GPN direction (whitelist/blacklist), real protocol strategy, live Global VPN panel
milestones.desc: GPN whitelist/blacklist direction, a real protocol strategy, and a live Global VPN panel.

milestones.title: Organise Temalar/: per-theme CSS files + section maps
milestones.desc: Theme code is split into per-theme CSS files with section maps.

milestones.title: Split the dashboard into external CSS/JS under Temalar/
milestones.desc: The dashboard slimmed from ~280 KB to ~100 KB by externalizing CSS and JS.

milestones.title: Fix top-bar theme button + move language selector next to it
milestones.desc: The theme button in the title bar is clickable again and the language selector sits beside it.

milestones.title: Node pool: pull nodes from your own link list + country/favorite/recent sorting
milestones.desc: A node pool pulls from your own link list, with country / favorite / recent sorting.
